text:
deploybot: HOTFIX REQUEST — patch release/2026.03.12-hotfix -> prod (eu-west1). Root cause: KV cache index corruption causing intermittent 503s for embeddings. Change window: immediate. Roll strategy: prefer rollforward, fallback pin to release/2026.03.05. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/release:2026.03.12-hotfix

kayla: oncall ack, I can monitor the cutover. Need rollback image tag and expected downtime?

ben: rollback tag is release:2026.03.05. Downtime expected < 60s during drain + keepalive swap. Can we keep canary at 5% for 10m?

oliver: agree 5% canary for 10m makes sense. Are e2e smoke tests green?

maria: running quick smoke now: `/test infra-smoke eu-west1` -> in progress. Will post results in 3m.

kayla: release-notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/2026.03.12-hotfix (private). Added brief note for customer support.

ben: approval from infra: :thumbsup: 

oliver: approval from eng-release: :thumbsup: 

maria: smoke tests passed: all checks green (latency P50 steady, embeds OK). Proceed when ops signs off.

kayla: ops signed: I approve. Initiating deploy.

deploybot: `/deploy hotfix release/2026.03.12-hotfix --env=prod --region=eu-west1 --canary=5% --canary-duration=10m`

deploybot: Deploy started. CI artifact verified, image pull OK. Endpoint drain scheduled.

ben: monitoring telemetry dashboards — no spike so far. If error rate >1% in 3m we rollback to release:2026.03.05 using `kubectl set image deploy/llm-worker gcr.io/redwood/release:2026.03.05` and remove traffic.

oliver: noted rollback command and owner: ben will execute, kayla will coordinate CS comms.

maria: :raised_hands: Nice work. postmortem checklist saved to the release doc.

deploybot: Deploy succeeded. Canary healthy, promoted to 100% after 10m. Marking thread resolved.
